gold_decisions.identity_explanation: Both entries identify the covariance ODE/proof defect caused by omitting the transpose in the second Lyapunov drift term. This changes the required transpose-partner ordering from Sigma_t P_t C_{*,t}^{-1} to Sigma_t C_{*,t}^{-1}P_t; for noncommuting matrices the resulting derivative is nonsymmetric and therefore cannot be a covariance derivative.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The Gaussian covariance evolution uses the wrong matrix ordering because the second drift factor is not transposed. In the noncommuting case this makes the stated covariance derivative asymmetric, invalidating the general covariance ODE while leaving the Gaussian closure and mean equation unaffected.

component_coverage.gold_component: The covariance evolution/proof uses Sigma_t P_t C_{*,t}^{-1} instead of the transpose-correct Sigma_t C_{*,t}^{-1}P_t, so the general ODE is false for noncommuting matrices and can produce a nonsymmetric covariance derivative.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: ISSUE-001 states the Lyapunov covariance identity, explicitly identifies the omitted transpose on A, explains the resulting noncommuting ordering mismatch and nonsymmetry, and supplies the corresponding corrected ordering.
